comparison.objective: Place a hot pot safely on a trivet; candidate commissions and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Load-bearing transport and safe support alignment versus precision tool engagement, rotary tuning, stabilization, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Pot supported by the trivet without hazardous tablecloth contact versus two safe stops without bottoming, overload, rebound, or drift.
comparison.reason: Safe placement of a hot vessel does not test dynamic mechanism adjustment. Board setup and scoring are missing.
